items.detail: Listed questionable with an illness (brief only says Day-To-Day); decision expected closer to the 7:30pm ET tip, and Andre Drummond would start at center if he sits.
Questionable with a left foot contusion after missing the last two games; Scoot Henderson and Jrue Holiday named as likely to absorb minutes if he sits.
Listed probable with a right hip impingement after missing the last four games; no minutes limit reported.
Not on the injury report; Memphis frontcourt is thin with Jerami Grant (left calf strain) and Cameron Boozer (right ankle sprain) both out, which supports his role for the rebounds prop.

note: Flagg, Gafford, Hart not on any injury report; no BOS@SAC news found beyond the official report.
